rca of the issue: The invisible-button bug is a CSS cascade / component variant contract issue: WaitlistForm.jsx uses <Button variant='outline'> for the X + Copy actions. The shadcn `outline` variant sets `border-input bg-background hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground` but does NOT set a base text color — it relies on inherited color. When the parent Landing.jsx section applies `text-white` (line 170: `bg-ink-900 text-white`) that inherited color propagates through the WaitlistForm's success card (bg-white) and into the two outline buttons, making them invisible. The LinkedIn button is unaffected because it explicitly sets `text-white` on `bg-brand-600` (visible). Fix is 1 word per line: add `text-ink-900` (dark gray) to the outline buttons' className so they always render dark-on-light regardless of the ancestor text-color scope.
